# Live Sports TV

> Watch Free Live Sports TV Channels Online in HD

LiveSportsTV (https://livesportstv.store/) is an open, high-speed directory and web player indexing legally broadcasted, free-to-air (FTA) sports television streams from 64+ countries worldwide.

## Live Sports Disciplines & Category Hubs
- [All Sports Directory](https://livesportstv.store/): Global directory of 1,000+ verified live sports TV channels with instant HLS playback.
- [Football & Soccer TV](https://livesportstv.store/football.html): Live football channels broadcasting FIFA World Cup qualifiers, UEFA competitions, domestic leagues, and continental championships.
- [Cricket TV](https://livesportstv.store/cricket.html): Live cricket feeds covering ICC tournaments, bilateral Test series, ODI matches, and domestic leagues (IPL, BBL, PSL).
- [Formula 1 & Motorsport](https://livesportstv.store/f1.html): Formula 1, MotoGP, rally, NASCAR, and endurance motorsport TV channels.
- [Basketball TV](https://livesportstv.store/basketball.html): NBA games, EuroLeague, FIBA international tournaments, and collegiate basketball broadcasts.
- [Combat Sports & UFC](https://livesportstv.store/combat.html): UFC Fight Nights, world championship boxing bouts, MMA, and ONE Championship feeds.
- [Tennis TV](https://livesportstv.store/tennis.html): Grand Slam tennis, ATP Tour, WTA tournaments, and Davis Cup matches.

## Editorial & Support Resources
- [Sports Broadcasting Guide](https://livesportstv.store/guide.html): Comprehensive guide to free-to-air sports broadcasting, hardware acceleration, and player configuration.
- [FAQ](https://livesportstv.store/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about legal compliance, stream availability, and device support.

- [Contact & DMCA](https://livesportstv.store/contact.html): Contact and copyright takedown compliance.

## Technical Specifications
- Stream Protocol: HTTP Live Streaming (HLS / .m3u8)
- In-Browser Player: HTML5 Video with HLS.js adaptive bitrate support
- Cost & Access: 100% Free, no subscription, no registration, no app downloads required
- Legal Compliance: Pure search and indexing interface. Media streams connect directly to original broadcaster origin servers.
